Submission Instructions

  1. Create a feature branch in your repository and invite your partner as a collaborator or work via fork/PR.
  2. Concurrently edit the same line of TEI XML in both branches to produce an intentional merge conflict.
  3. Open the conflicted file in VS Code, evaluate both conflicting readings against your facsimile evidence, combine them correctly into a single valid TEI block, and delete all conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>).
  4. Verify well-formedness with xmllint --noout and complete the merge commit.
  5. Run a complete validation sweep on all TEI XML files in your project directory against the official TEI All Relax NG schema, verifying zero validation errors.
  6. Submit your merged Git commit hash, terminal validation sweep log, and a 300–500 word reflection on how continuous integration safeguards scholarly editions against accidental regression.
